text: Two ICC Premier Partners sit at the top of chains that end with the Government of Dubai (Emirates, via the Dubai government's investment arm; DP World, whose ultimate owner the company states is the Government of Dubai). Human Rights Watch documented that in 2024 a UAE court sentenced 43 Emirati activists and dissidents to life imprisonment after a mass trial, and that the Federal Supreme Court upheld the convictions in March 2025.

source.name: Human Rights Watch: UAE: 43 Life Sentences in 'Flagrant Injustice' (mass trial) and follow-up on upheld convictions
